race.comment: PYROLYSIS (5) appeals strongly fresh, with an easy Doomben trial behind her and last campaign form that reads well for a race of this depth first-up. She was beaten as favourite at both runs before the break, but both had genuine excuses. Can return with a bang. VENOM RUSH (12) finds a nice race to kick off the prep and has been readied with two trials. There's peaks from last prep that measure right up for this. Not taking lightly. UNFAITHFUL (7) looms as one of the other main threats after winning a BM65 on the Poly first-up. Has plenty of scope for improvement and gets in light with the claim over a track and trip she's already won at. LIFE AFTER LOVE (11) is knocking on the door and should be at her top now. Holds appeal.
